name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
summary: Health insurance providing cover of Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation to eligible poor and vulnerable families.

eligibility_clauses.text: The family must be identified as an eligible household under the SECC deprivation criteria or an eligible occupational category.
The applicant must be a resident household of the concerned State/UT.
There is no cap on family size or age of members under the scheme.

entitlement_rules.text: Eligible families receive an annual health cover of Rs. 5,00,000 per family (shared across members) for hospitalisation.

appeal_hierarchy.description: Raise a grievance at the empanelled hospital.
Escalation to the State Health Agency grievance cell.
